settingsAdsPremium: You're completely ad-free — no videos ever needed. Thanks for supporting Mindset Frames.
settingsAdsFree: The only ads in the app are optional rewarded videos you can choose to watch to unlock temporary premium access — up to 2 per day. No banner ads, pop-ups, or any other ads — ever.
settingsNoBackup: No backup yet — tap Sync now
settingsSignOutConfirm: Sign out? Your data stays on this device. You can sign back in anytime to re-sync.
settingsDeleteConfirm: Delete your account and all cloud data? This cannot be undone. Your habits stay on this device.
settingsReportDesc: A polished, high-resolution report — completion stats, daily chart, mood mix, and habit breakdown — for a full month or any date range you choose.
settingsIncludedPremium: Included with Premium — start the free 7-day trial or unlock once to export reports.
settingsSavedDownloads: A copy is also saved to your Downloads folder.
settingsPickMonth: Pick a month to export as a high-resolution PDF — or choose your own date range.
settingsTooLong: That's %d days — reports cover up to %d days (about a year). Pick a shorter range.
settingsPickStartEnd: Pick a start and end date — any period up to a year.
settingsDarkDesc: Dark is a deep, high-contrast theme — easy on the eyes at night and battery-friendly on OLED screens. You can also flip themes anytime with the sun/moon button on the Today screen.
settingsLanguageDesc: Choose the app's display language. English (US & UK) is free everywhere, and your region's language is unlocked free on this device — all other languages come with Premium.
settingsLanguagePaywallTitle: Experience daily reflection in your native language
settingsLanguagePaywallBody: Unlock 23 more world languages & localized quotes with Premium!
settingsLongPress: Long-press a preset to change its default time.
settingsReminderUpdated: Reminder updated — you'll be nudged daily at %s.
settingsPreviewSent: Preview sent — check your notification shade. It looks exactly like the real daily reminder.
settingsPreviewSentReal: Preview sent with this week's real numbers — check your notification shade.
settingsNotificationsBlocked: Notifications are not allowed. Enable them for Mindset Frames in system settings, then try again.
settingsEveningAlertDesc: Alerts you only if today's habits aren't done yet
settingsStreakUpdated: Updated — we'll check your progress daily at %s.
settingsStreakSilent: If everything is already checked off by then, the alert stays silent — no nagging.
settingsStreakCheckupDesc: We'll look at your progress at this time each day and only alert you if habits are still unchecked. An evening time works best.
settingsSundayRecapDesc: A short summary like “You checked in 5/7 days”
settingsRecapArrives: Arrives Sunday evening around 6:00 PM. One notification a week — strong weeks get celebrated, quiet weeks get a fresh start. Never a guilt trip.
settingsRecapPreviewSent: Preview sent with this week's real numbers — check your notification shade.
settingsAboutDesc: Your data lives on this device and works fully offline. Optional cloud backup is offered on the Today screen and keeps your progress safe if you switch devices.

companionEmpty: 🌱 I'm here with you. What's one thing you're planning today?
companionNone: 😌 The day's still open — one small frame and we're moving.
companionPartial: 🙂 Look at you go — a few more and today is yours.
companionAllDone: 🥳 Every frame done — I'm genuinely proud of you today.
ntfPreviewNote: This is a preview from Settings — your real reminder will arrive at its scheduled time.
ntfChannelCheckInDesc: Reminds you to complete your daily mindset check-in.
ntfCheckInEmptyText: What are you working on these days?
ntfCheckInEmptyBig: I noticed your habit list is still empty — no pressure at all. Tell me one thing you're planning: reading a few pages, a short walk, drinking more water… anything. We'll turn it into one tiny daily habit and I'll keep you company along the way.
ntfCheckInMissedText: No guilt — today is a fresh frame.
ntfCheckInMissedBig: Yesterday came and went without a check-in, and honestly? That happens to everyone — even the most productive people drop a day. What matters is today. Check off one small habit and we're right back on track together. I believe in you.
ntfCheckInStreakText: Check in now to keep your streak alive.
ntfCheckInStreakBig30: You've built an incredible %d-day streak! Don't let it slip away — check in now, pick your mood, and mark today's habits.
ntfCheckInStreakBig7: Your %d-day streak is waiting! One quick check-in today keeps it going. Pick your mood and mark off your habits.
ntfCheckInStreakBigLow: You're on a %d-day streak! Check in now to keep it alive — pick your mood and mark today's habits.
ntfCheckInDoneText: Keep up the momentum — check your habits anytime.
ntfCheckInDoneBig: You've already checked in today. Come back to mark off more habits or switch your mood frame.
ntfCheckInDefaultText: Take a moment to check in with your mindset and habits.
ntfCheckInDefaultBig: Take a moment to check in with your mindset and habits. Pick your mood and mark off today's habits to start building a streak.
ntfChannelStreakDesc: Alerts you in the evening when today's habits aren't done yet.
ntfStreakPreviewText: This is how we warn you when habits are unfinished.
ntfStreakPreviewBig: On days when your habits aren't all checked off by this time, you'll get an alert like this. When everything is already done, we stay silent — no nagging.
ntfStreakRiskText: No habits checked yet — don't let it slip.
ntfStreakRiskBig30: It took %d days to build this streak and only one missed evening to lose it. Check off just one habit before midnight to keep it alive.
ntfStreakRiskBig7: %d days strong — but nothing is checked off today. One quick check-in before midnight keeps your streak going.
ntfStreakRiskBigLow: You're %d days in, but today is still empty. Check off a habit before midnight to keep your streak alive.
ntfStreakNoneText: Nothing checked off yet — there's still time.
ntfStreakNoneBig: The day isn't over. Check off even one habit tonight and tomorrow you'll have a streak to protect.
ntfStreakPartialBig: You've completed %1$d of %2$d today — %3$d more before midnight closes today's ring.
ntfChannelRecapDesc: One Sunday-evening summary of your check-ins this week.
ntfRecapPreviewText: Every Sunday: “You checked in 5/7 days this week.”
ntfRecapPreviewBig: Once your habits are set up, this recap lands every Sunday evening — how many days you checked in and how the week felt. One notification a week, nothing more.
ntfRecapPerfectTitle: Perfect week — you checked in 7/7 days
ntfRecapPerfectText: Every single day on the board.
ntfRecapPerfectBig: Seven for seven this week.%1$s Whatever you're doing, it's working — see you Monday.%2$s
ntfRecapStrongTitle: Strong week — you checked in %d/7 days
ntfRecapStrongBig: You showed up %1$d of 7 days.%2$s That's the kind of week streaks are built on — fancy one more day next week?%3$s
ntfRecapMidTitle: You checked in %d/7 days this week
ntfRecapMidText: A real foundation to build on.
ntfRecapMidBig: %1$d days had at least one habit checked.%2$s Small weeks stack into big changes — lead with your easiest habit tomorrow.%3$s
ntfRecapLowTitle: You checked in %d/7 days this week
ntfRecapLowText: Showing up at all still counts.
ntfRecapLowBig: Life clearly had other plans this week — and you still checked in %1$d of 7 days. Tomorrow starts a clean week; one small habit is all it takes.%2$s
ntfRecapEmptyText: Last week stayed quiet — that's okay.
ntfRecapEmptyBig: No check-ins last week, and no guilt about it. Tomorrow is a blank page — open the app, pick your mood, and check off one tiny habit.
ntfRecapShareText:
I showed up %d/7 days this week 🌿 Small habits, real momentum.

Mindset Frames — track habits that adapt to your mood.
#MindsetFrames #HabitTracker #WeeklyWins
ntfChannelCompanionDesc: Payment reminders before your trial ends and heads-ups before temporary access expires.
ntfChannelReflectionDesc: A gentle reflection question each evening.
ntfTrialText: A friendly heads-up — no surprise charges, ever.
ntfTrialBig: Hey, it's your companion. Your 7-day free trial wraps up in about 24 hours. If this week helped, do nothing — your plan continues at the price shown in Google Play. Not ready? Cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions and you won't be charged a cent. Either way, I'm glad we spent this week together.
ntfAdPassText: Premium features will gently lock again soon.
ntfAdPassBig: Enjoying the extra room? In about %d minutes your Ad Pass winds down and the premium features lock again. Don't worry — nothing is deleted; your extra habits just wait for next time. Want it all unlocked 24/7? The Founding Member offer is ₱35 for your first month, with a 7-day free trial first.
ntfReflectionTitle: A quiet moment before the day ends 🌙
ntfReflectionBigSuffix: No need to write anything down — just sit with it for a breath. And if you'd like, your frames are waiting.
ntfReflection1: Before the day closes — what's one small thing you're glad you did today?
ntfReflection2: Quick thought as the evening settles: what felt heavy today, and what felt lighter than expected?
ntfReflection3: If today had a color, what would it be? No wrong answers — just noticing counts.
ntfReflection4: One honest line: what did today teach you that yesterday couldn't?
ntfReflection5: What would you tell this morning's you, now that you know how the day went?
ntfReflection6: Somewhere in today there was a tiny win. I'd love for you to name it.
ntfReflection7: How's your heart this evening? Even a ten-second check-in counts.
